note: Simulator parameters. Values marked guess have no source; change them here, not in code.

segments.calibrated: T-23: fitted to BATON-Sample human driving (2 drivers, 19 h), comma2k19 as a check; docs/REALDATA.md (highway weight, stop dwell)

driver.calibrated: T-23: fitted to BATON-Sample human driving (2 drivers, 19 h), comma2k19 as a check; docs/REALDATA.md (accel, decel, wobble, smoothing)

passenger.source: MSSQ: Golding 2006. log sd: robust (IQR) spread of TU Delft per-person K after the MSSQ rule, ml/verify/out/K_lpf.npy

road_profile.note: AR(1) grade noise along distance, vertical motion v^2 dtheta/ds
road_profile.calibrated: T-23: fitted to BATON-Sample human driving (2 drivers, 19 h), comma2k19 as a check; docs/REALDATA.md (rms_z_1m)

sway.note: lane-keeping lateral acceleration, sd proportional to speed
sway.calibrated: T-23: fitted to BATON-Sample human driving (2 drivers, 19 h), comma2k19 as a check; docs/REALDATA.md (rms_y_1m)

label.input: kinematic horizontal acceleration (no gravity, no vibration), 0.63 Hz low-pass as in ml/oman.py
label.source: PRD Q6; noise sd is a guess, held for 1 minute so the 5-minute max is not inflated
